# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper / Servant  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha Pratt is a housekeeper who wears an apron as part of her domestic routine.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001)_

## Personality

Tabitha is a brisk, fierce, and fiercely loyal housekeeper who develops an unreasoning devotion to her employer, Nell Carrow. Although initially suspicious and envious toward visitors like Thirza Abernethy, she becomes accepting once she sees her domain is respected and recognizes Thirza's proper demeanor. She is practical, taking charge of household matters during moments of crisis and prioritizing physical nourishment for those who are distressed or exhausted.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)_

## Goals

- To care for and protect Nell and her infant child  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)</sub>

## History

Tabitha Pratt went to work at the little house of dreams as a servant for Dr. Hugh Carrow and his wife Nell. During her first few weeks, she developed an intense devotion to Nell, whom she called "young Mrs. Doctor." When Thirza Abernethy arrived at the house in June carrying her horsehair trunk, Tabitha initially regarded her with envious suspicion. However, after Thirza refrained from interfering with kitchen duties or Tabitha's care of Nell, Tabitha declared to her friends in the Glen that Thirza was a fine woman who understood her place. During the intense night when Nell went into labor, Tabitha waited in the kitchen with cotton wool stuffed in her ears and her apron over her head. When Thirza expressed fear that the birth might end tragically, Tabitha fiercely rejected the notion that God would rob them of Nell. After the baby girl was successfully delivered and Hugh brought the news downstairs, Tabitha removed the cotton wool and briskly took charge of preparing breakfast for everyone.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005), [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P9](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0009), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)_
